major_findings: The source distinguishes lavish outward conduct and calculation inwardly from the separate claim that Tanlang uses money well but does not retain it; speculation is not inferred as an unconditional rule.
Yang/Tuo, Kong/Jie, Da Hao, Hua Lu, Hua Quan and Hua Ji have distinct conditional effects; Hua Lu does not erase the stated setback branch.
Fire/Bell, Lu Cun/Hua Lu and Kong/Jie form a conditional sudden-gain versus ruin branch; the source's advice to stop while ahead is retained without a numeric threshold or duration.
The Yin Sha, Tian Yue and Jie Sha claims are each gated by the source's closing qualifier that Yang/Tuo/Kong/Jie are also seen.
Zi/Wu, Yin/Shen, Yin, and Chen/Xu palace-position branches are kept separate; the Ziwei, Lian Zhen, Wu Qu, Po Jun and Lu-Ma dependencies are not generalized.
Printed p86 visibly reads 『风流采杖』. W06-596 is retained as an audit row but not promoted; W06-SG-005 records the unresolved named-setup wording.
The word 一生 remains source-native qualitative wording; no DECADE/YEAR layer, probability, weight, duration, threshold, frequency, or decay is inferred.
